The main takeaway from our work is that
the solvation dynamics of the “van der Waals complexes” is not described by the SVE.

in the case of a large number of solute-solvent pairs, the configurational solvation dynamics is controlled by the large-wavevectors processes, which are essentially slower than the small-wavevector ones.
